label: Email yourself a daily quote on weekdays and a joke on weekends
description: This workflow fetches an inspirational quote on weekdays, and a joke on the weekends and then sends it to the email address you specify.

triggers.description: Starts the workflow every day at 08:00 London time. The run's date and time are passed on to the weekend check.
triggers.label: Daily
triggers.name: trigger_1

tasks.description: Checks whether the trigger's date falls on a Saturday or Sunday (London time) and returns true or false. The next step uses this to choose between a joke and a quote.
tasks.label: Check if its the weekend
tasks.name: dateHelper_1

tasks.description: Routes the run on the weekend check. True (weekend) runs the joke branch; false (weekday) runs the quote branch.
tasks.label: Quote or a joke
tasks.name: condition_1

caseFalse.description: Weekday branch: fetches a random quote from dummyjson.com. Its quote text and author are used in the email that follows.
caseFalse.label: Get a random quote
caseFalse.name: httpClient_1

caseFalse.description: Weekday branch: emails the quote, with the author in the subject and the quote as the body. Set the recipient address in the To field.
caseFalse.label: Send the quote
caseFalse.name: googleMail_2

caseTrue.description: Weekend branch: fetches a random joke from the Official Joke API. Its setup and punchline are used in the email that follows.
caseTrue.label: Get a random joke
caseTrue.name: httpClient_2

caseTrue.description: Weekend branch: emails the joke, with the setup in the subject and the punchline as the body. Set the recipient address in the To field.
caseTrue.label: Send the joke
caseTrue.name: googleMail_1

stickyNotes.content:
## Setup: send it to yourself

1. Add your Gmail connection to **Send the joke** and **Send the quote**, and enter your address in **To** in both.
2. Click **Test** to send one now: a joke on weekends, a quote on weekdays.
3. The **Daily** trigger runs at 08:00 London time. Change the time or time zone there if you need to.
4. Publish and deploy the project to start the daily emails.
